svg.title: Activation B: Use the subtotal, then ask for the charge
svg.desc: Four snapshots: replay recreates activity 0 and matches its earlier schedule. The result delivered for this step supplies 100, recomputes 110 and opens activity 1 at L4, then Schedule 1 is returned. Activation B. Matching the earlier Schedule 0 removes the candidate, not the task. After all earlier records are read, IsReplaying is false before completion 0 advances L2, L3 and L4 and computes 110. The runner returns only the new Schedule 1. Source based educational snapshots, not an executed runtime trace.
svg.text: Activation B: Use the subtotal, then ask for the charge
A new local task receives the newly arrived subtotal.
TaskCompletionSource is the helper that supplies an awaited task's result.
Core supplies serialized results. These cards show decoded example values.
public sealed class OrderFlow : TaskOrchestrator<string, string>
public override async Task<string> RunAsync(TaskOrchestrationContext context, string input)

g.text: Start again with fresh local state
The old start event reruns L1 and L2. No task object is carried over from A.
New events for this step: 0 of 1 read
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Not saved for the next pass
Candidate 0 and its result task are new objects, for the same durable activity.
Match the schedule. Keep waiting at L2.
TaskScheduled 0 removed candidate 0. All earlier records have been read.
New events for this step: 0 of 1 read
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Not saved for the next pass
IsReplaying is false before the newly delivered completion 0. The local task still waits.
One completion advances L2, L3 and L4
Completion 0 supplies 100. The continuation computes 110 and reaches L4.
No events left in this pass
New events for this step: 1 of 1 read
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Fresh local helper for this pass
This is one event handler with its continuation settled, not one event per line.
Return only the new charge request
Candidate 1 has no matching schedule in this pass. It is returned as new work.
No events left in this pass
New events for this step: 1 of 1 read
History stays. Only the cursor moves.
Not saved for the next pass
Schedule 1 carries order-42 and 110. ReadSubtotal is not scheduled again.

svg.text: These are settled checkpoints, not a debugger capture or measured service batches.
SetResult can run the continuation before Core removes the entry from openTasks.
IDs 0 and 1 correlate durable activities. They are not .NET Task.Id or history positions.
Read history stays stored. Local tasks and variable slots are not saved for the next pass.
Housekeeping records are omitted. IsReplaying describes a phase, not a permanent state.
